# Semantic components

The callouts below retain visible labels, use distinct but desaturated colors,
and remain understandable without color.

> [!NOTE]
> Notes provide useful context without interrupting the primary workflow.

> [!TIP]
> Tips suggest an easier or more reliable way to complete a task.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Important information affects the outcome and should be read before acting.

> [!WARNING]
> Warnings describe a condition that can cause an incorrect result.

> [!CAUTION]
> Cautions identify an action that can have difficult-to-reverse consequences.

> **Planned**
> Planned content is approved intent and is not presented as current behavior.

## Table

| Element | Purpose | Expected treatment |
|---|---|---|
| Heading | Establish hierarchy | Distinct font and spacing |
| Callout | Surface semantic context | Label, border, and muted fill |
| Table | Compare structured values | Light rules and readable padding |
| Footnote | Preserve supporting detail | Compact text near the page foot |
